How much is a used Sony WH-1000XM5 worth?

The WH-1000XM5 kept its value well, but since the XM6 came out in 2025 used prices have moved. Check the current market before buying to resell.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The XM5 does not fold, has a slimmer headband and the model name inside the band. It comes in a flat folding case. The XM4 folds and has a different case.

What decides the price

  • Condition: the soft finish shows marks; earpads wear.
  • Case: the original case is expected.
  • Battery and noise cancelling: both sides should work.
  • Authenticity: copies exist; buy from sellers who can show the box and receipt.

Check before you buy

  • Pair with the Sony app and test noise cancelling and the touch panel.
  • Look at the hinges and sliders.
  • Ask for the receipt or the box with the serial number.

Where it sells best

Sells well on eBay and Vinted. Photos with the case and a clean headband help.

Today's price

Prices for a used Sony WH-1000XM5 change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. Questions

How much is a used Sony WH-1000XM5 worth?

It depends on condition, case, battery and authenticity. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Sony WH-1000XM5" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

Did the XM6 lower the price of the XM5?

Yes, new generations push used prices of the previous one down. The XM5 still sells steadily, so check the current price.

Are XM5 headphones without a case worth less?

Yes, buyers expect the case. Without it, price it lower.
